يرتجعوا (form VIII)
# يَرْتَجِعُوا (yartajiʕū) /jar.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# يُرْتَجَعُوا (yurtajaʕū) /jur.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
